args.prompt: Continue the same dark cinematic pirate-sea storm from the previous shot. The camera advances low through violent black waves, heavy diagonal rain, wind-driven spray, fog and moving mist toward the same three-masted wooden ship. The ship pitches and rolls naturally; torn sails and rigging react to the wind. Lightning must behave as brief storm flashes rather than a permanent glowing decoration: the scene falls back into deep darkness between flashes, then a later flash illuminates a different part of the sky and briefly reveals more of the ship and white foam. Preserve photorealistic scale, wet surfaces, coherent ship identity, continuous forward camera movement, and no cut.
args.negative_prompt: static image, frozen sea, frozen rain, stationary ship, continuous glowing lightning, permanently visible bolt, daylight, calm water, cartoon, illustration, text, logo, watermark, duplicated ship, warped masts, camera teleport, sudden cut
